title: A microglial circadian clock sculpts synapses during neurodevelopment
title_zh: 小胶质细胞昼夜节律钟在神经发育期间塑造突触
abstract: In a recent study, Routh and colleagues demonstrated that the circadian clock regulates microglia-directed synaptic refinement during a critical period of neurodevelopment in mice, in a sex-dependent manner. Loss of the major circadian rhythm regulator, Bmal1, in microglia induced a proinflammatory state and excessive pruning of synapses, primarily in adolescent male mice.
abstract_zh: 在最近的一项研究中，Routh 等人证明昼夜节律钟在小胶质细胞介导的突触精细化过程中起作用，并在小鼠神经发育的关键期以性别相关方式调节该过程。小胶质细胞中主要昼夜节律调节因子 Bmal1 的缺失导致炎性状态升高和突触过度修剪，主要发生在青春期雄性小鼠中。
